description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to selecting codecs and copiers for serialization and copying operations in the Orleans framework. It includes interfaces for customizable type support determination and specific implementations that utilize delegate functions for runtime flexibility.

classes.name: ICodecSelector
classes.description: An interface for selecting a codec for a specific type, used for serialization.

classes.name: ICopierSelector
classes.description: An interface for selecting a copier for a specific type, used for copying objects.

classes.name: DelegateCodecSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICodecSelector using a delegate for custom logic.

classes.name: DelegateCopierSelector
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ICopierSelector using a delegate for custom logic.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a given type is supported by the codec or copier, implemented via delegate.
